description: This Java class provides a variety of utility functions for handling strings within the OFBiz framework, including string replacement, joining, splitting, encoding/decoding, path manipulation, and special string handling techniques. It also defines an inner StringWrapper class for ease of string manipulation in template environments.

classes.name: StringWrapper
classes.description: A lightweight object for wrapping a String, used mainly within FreeMarker templates to avoid automatic HTML encoding.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a specified old string with a new string within a given main string, searching from the end backwards.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Concatenates a collection of objects into a single string, separated by a specified delimiter.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a list based on a specified delimiter (or whitespace if null).

methods.name: splitWithStringSeparator
methods.description: Splits a string using a specified string as the separator.

methods.name: strToMap
methods.description: Converts a delimited string of key-value pairs into a Map, decoding URL-encoded components.

methods.name: mapToStr
methods.description: Converts a Map into an encoded string with key-value pairs separated by '=' and pairs separated by '|'.

methods.name: cleanUpPathPrefix
methods.description: Ensures a path string starts with '/' and does not end with '/', converting backslashes to forward slashes.

methods.name: removeSpaces
methods.description: Removes all spaces from the input string.

methods.name: toHexString
methods.description: Converts a byte array into its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: cleanHexString
methods.description: Removes spaces and colons from a hex string.

methods.name: fromHexString
methods.description: Converts a hex string back into a byte array.

methods.name: encodeInt
methods.description: Encodes an integer into a hexadecimal character array.

methods.name: removeNonNumeric
methods.description: Removes all non-numeric characters from a string.

methods.name: removeRegex
methods.description: Removes all substrings matching a regex pattern from an input string.

methods.name: addToNumberString
methods.description: Adds a numeric value to a string representing a number, preserving leading zeros.

methods.name: padNumberString
methods.description: Pads a numeric string with leading zeros to a specified minimum length.

methods.name: convertOperatorSubstitutions
methods.description: Converts special operator placeholders (@and, @or, etc.) back to their original symbolic form in expressions.

methods.name: truncateEncodedStringToLength
methods.description: Truncates a string to a specified length, properly handling special-encoded characters and adding ellipsis if needed.

methods.name: getTruncateStartLimit
methods.description: Calculates the safe starting index for truncation, ensuring special characters are not cut.

methods.name: getTruncateEndLimit
methods.description: Calculates the safe ending index for truncation, ensuring special characters are not cut.

methods.name: wrapString
methods.description: Creates a StringWrapper for a given string.

methods.name: makeStringWrapper
methods.description: Creates a StringWrapper instance, or returns an empty wrapper if the string is empty.
